title: 皐月賞の後に・一冠達成

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After claiming victory in the Satsuki Sho, Symboli Rudolf raises one finger high. The message is clear: one crown down, two to go. Up next is the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Air Groove and the general manager visit the waiting room, where Symboli Rudolf waxes lyrical about her dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Moved, the general manager decides to remain in the student council, but Air Groove seems displeased with Rudolf's handling of the situation.
